# RcRequestGimbalCtrPermission (command)

RC RequestGimbalCtrPermission - empty payload. Receiver is DeviceType.osd (14), not RC - DJI's own class targets that device type despite the cmdset being named RC. Does NOT appear to be a prerequisite for interactive gimbal control - an exhaustive call-site search of the real dji.pilot app found this used only for the RC master/slave handoff scenario and the third-party Mobile SDK layer, never in the app's own single-pilot FPV gimbal UI (which uses GimbalSpeedControl instead, with permission embedded in that packet). Consistent with this command never getting a reply despite being sent before every AngleControl/AbsAngleControl attempt in earlier testing.

**Confidence:** V

**Provenance:** dji.pilot decompile, DataRcRequestGimbalCtrPermission.java. Was app/awto_dji_app/lib/link/gimbal_commands.dart's `permissionRequest()` and scripts/re/duml_commands.py's `RcRequestGimbalCtrPermission`/ `gimbal.requestCtrPermission`.
